about: This machine's heavy gates for a repository that marks none of its own, `heavyGates` in driver.json (HEAVYRUN1b2a, D180's HEAVYRUN1b2a note): the table both twins hold, the CLI's driverconfig.ts and the driver's HeavyMapping. Each `read` row is the value a file holds under `heavyGates` (the file is `{"heavyGates": <value>}`) and the map each twin reads from it: by repository, each name trimmed, a blank one passed over, a name written twice in any case read where first readable; each a list of gates in the order they run, read only where it is a list of one gate or more, every one an object whose `name` and `run` are text with something in it (kept trimmed) and whose `cwd` is absent, null, blank (none) or a folder under the repository's root (kept trimmed: no `:`, not starting with `/` or `\`, no `..` part), no name twice in any case; a list with any gate that does not read is not read, whole; what a gate has no field for is passed over.

read.name: a repository's gates in the order they run, a gate's folder kept
names, commands and folders read trimmed, a blank or null folder none
what a gate has no field for is passed over
a list with a gate that does not read is not read, whole, and another repository's still is
a blank name or a blank command is no gate
a name, a command or a folder that is no text is no gate
a gate named twice in any case is no list
a folder is one under the repository's root: rooted, a drive, a share or climbing out is no list
an empty list, a gate that is no list, and an entry that is no object are none
a blank repository is passed over, and one written twice in any case is read where first readable
a map that is no object is none
